headline: Vegan protein meals delivered for busy parents
body: Skip the evening scramble. Get plant-based protein dinners on the table in minutes. Loved by families who need quick and healthy weeknight meals without the hassle.
rationale: This copy targets the busy parent persona by directly addressing their need to save time on weeknight dinners while ensuring their family gets plant-based protein. It uses their specific trust language and avoids luxury or complex onboarding terms.
